problem_text:
A shipping company must select packages to load onto a cargo plane. Available packages are:
* Package 1: volume 3 cubic meters, revenue $59
* Package 2: volume 29 cubic meters, revenue $153
* Package 3: volume 49 cubic meters, revenue $181
* Package 4: volume 17 cubic meters, revenue $237
* Package 5: volume 2 cubic meters, revenue $185
* Package 6: volume 47 cubic meters, revenue $174
* Package 7: volume 41 cubic meters, revenue $134
* Package 8: volume 23 cubic meters, revenue $195
* Package 9: volume 23 cubic meters, revenue $202
* Package 10: volume 13 cubic meters, revenue $18
* Package 11: volume 26 cubic meters, revenue $285
* Package 12: volume 20 cubic meters, revenue $215
* Package 13: volume 39 cubic meters, revenue $21
* Package 14: volume 35 cubic meters, revenue $70
* Package 15: volume 21 cubic meters, revenue $22
* Package 16: volume 28 cubic meters, revenue $83
* Package 17: volume 6 cubic meters, revenue $74
* Package 18: volume 4 cubic meters, revenue $294
* Package 19: volume 19 cubic meters, revenue $110
* Package 20: volume 49 cubic meters, revenue $195
* Package 21: volume 16 cubic meters, revenue $299
* Package 22: volume 6 cubic meters, revenue $124
The aircraft's cargo hold has a maximum capacity of 361 cubic meters. Choose the package combination that yields the highest total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each package is either fully loaded or not loaded.
